title: AI Sees Your Location—But With A Bias Toward The Wealthy World

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Vision-Language Model (VLM) geolocation accuracy and error distance on street view images from economically developed cities versus developing cities, categorized by global wealth and millionaire rankings.

Measuring the normalized entropy of city-level predictions to detect the over-prediction of well-known cities, and comparing geolocation performance between highly populated and sparsely populated regions using the FAIRLOCATOR benchmark.

Evaluating disparities in geolocation accuracy and geographic error distances across five distinct United Nations Regional Groups (e.g., Africa Group vs. Western European and Others Group) to identify cultural underrepresentation.
